packageRules.description: Supply-chain soak: automerged PRs rebase onto main first so CI ran against the current base
Attempt major updates automatically after a week; CI must pass before merge
Supply-chain soak: never automerge a GitHub Actions digest change. A moved tag on a SHA-pinned action shows up as a digest update; a human compares it against the upstream release first
Pre-1.0 updates use the same required CI gate
sharp is compiled against the libvips built in the Dockerfile; update them together so compatibility is proven by a single Docker build
Renovate engine: several releases a day, so take the weekly one; no digest pin because the annotated RENOVATE_VERSION env var holds a plain tag
Keep Node image, CI runtime, and Node types in one tested PR
Explain the 3-day release-age gate in PRs after applying package-specific policies
prBodyNotes: {{#unless isVulnerabilityAlert}}**Release-age gate:** `{{depName}}` requires **3 days** since release (not PR creation). See `renovate/stability-days` for the current status.{{/unless}}

{{#unless isVulnerabilityAlert}}If `renovate/stability-days` is pending, the release-age requirement is unmet or a required release timestamp is unavailable. Renovate rechecks on its scheduled runs; automerge also requires passing checks and an enabled automerge policy. The rebase/retry checkbox is optional and is not an approval request.{{/unless}}
